records.codeContent:
.route("keycloak-service", r -> r
    .path("/realms/**")
    .uri("http://localhost:8096"))  // URL directe de Keycloak

.route("user-node-service", r -> r
    .path("/EverCare/auth/**", 
          "/EverCare/users/**", 
          "/EverCare/admin/**")
    .filters(f -> f
        .rewritePath("/EverCare/(?<segment>.*)", "/${segment}")
        // Ajouter le forward des tokens
        .addRequestHeader("X-Forwarded-Proto", "http")
        .addRequestHeader("X-Forwarded-Host", "localhost:8089")
    )
